GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 332.1 (11 Sep 47) GA
(SCAPIN - 1773)
APO 500
11 September 1947
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Hoisting of Japanese National Flag.
1. There is no objection to the hoisting of the Japanese national flag on 24 September 1947, as requested by C.L.O. No. 6967(PH) dated 4 September 1947.
2. Occupation troops will be informed of this matter.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R.M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
